messages.text: Proposal v1: launch five integrations and self-service billing in four weeks.
Two engineers cannot credibly deliver that scope in four weeks. Start with one integration and a supervised pilot.
The acquisition channel is unvalidated. Invite five design partners before funding a public launch.
Proposal v2: one integration, supervised onboarding, and five design partners. Defer self-service billing and the public launch.
Final views on v2: Product Owner APPROVED; Lead Developer APPROVED; Marketing Manager INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE. Willingness to pay remains untested. Human decision: pending.
